title: Complete Kitchen Fitting
summary: Bespoke kitchens, expertly fitted to the highest standard.
details: A kitchen has to work hard every day and still look good doing it. We fit kitchens carefully and accurately, from the first measure through to the final adjustments, so doors line up, worktops sit true and the finish lasts.
includes: Finishing details such as end panels, plinths and trims
Replacing an existing kitchen or fitting a new one

title: Bathroom Renovations
summary: Modern, functional bathrooms built to last.
details: From a simple refresh to a complete renovation, we create bathrooms that are practical for everyday life and a pleasure to use, with careful attention to layout, storage and finish.
imageAlt: Bathroom with a freestanding bath and stone-effect tiles

title: Bespoke Joinery
summary: Custom storage, media walls and cabinetry.
details: Bespoke joinery makes the most of awkward spaces and adds character to a room. We design and build pieces around your home, whether that is a media wall, alcove units or made-to-measure cabinetry.
imageAlt: Media wall with a television and lit shelving

title: Fitted Wardrobes
details: Fitted wardrobes give you more storage from the same space. We build them to suit the room and the way you use it, with the right mix of hanging space, shelving and drawers.
includes: Wardrobes for alcoves and sloping ceilings

title: Flooring
details: The right floor ties a renovation together. We prepare and lay flooring with care so it looks right and stands up to everyday use.
includes: Flooring for single rooms or whole homes
imageAlt: Herringbone wooden floor in a bright room

title: Doors
summary: Supply and fitting of internal and external doors.
details: New doors can transform a home. We supply and fit internal and external doors, hung accurately so they open, close and latch properly.
imageAlt: Pale grey internal doors in a hallway
